root_cause: Blocked fuel pressure regulator causing elevated line pressure
corrective_action: Replaced fuel pressure regulator and fuel filter
notes: Fuel pressure was 10.45 bar at service, well above the 9.0 bar threshold. Regulator confirmed blocked. Post-fix reading: 5.6 bar.

root_cause: Oil pump bearing wear causing loss of lubrication pressure
corrective_action: Replaced oil pump and oil filter, refilled with fresh engine oil
notes: lub_oil_pressure dropped to 1.98 bar (critical threshold: 1.5 bar). Current live reading of 2.02 bar indicates continued degradation trend post-repair.

root_cause: Sluggish thermostat delaying coolant circulation, combined with low coolant pressure suggesting a slow leak
corrective_action: Replaced thermostat, flushed coolant, inspected and reseated pressure cap
notes: coolant_temp was approaching limit at 80.1°C. Current live reading of 82.4°C shows recurrence within 90 days — coolant system not fully resolved. coolant_pressure also remains low at 1.95 bar.

corrective_action: Oil and filter changed, oil pump inspected (early wear found, not yet replaced)
notes: lub_oil_pressure was 2.61 bar at last service — borderline. Current live reading is 2.72 bar, slightly improved but still near threshold. engine_rpm of 379 is low, consistent with oil-related idle instability.
